configurations.//: npm run dev is `wrangler dev`, which binds 8787 by default and takes a port ONLY via --port. Wrangler does not read the PORT environment variable, so autoPort must stay false — an assigned port would simply be ignored and the preview would point at the wrong place. The old value here was 3000, which never matched anything this project serves.
configurations.name: dev

configurations.//: Static preview of public/ for copy and layout checks when wrangler can't run (node_modules on this checkout holds the Windows workerd binary). No worker routes, so clean URLs like /browser 404; use the .html paths.
configurations.name: static
